## Results

<!-- statci: model=primary term=wt -->
Vehicle weight strongly reduced fuel economy (*b* = -5.34, SE = 0.56, *t*(30) = -9.56, 95% CI [-6.49, -4.20], *p* < .001).
Overall model fit across *N* = 32 vehicles was high ($R^2 = 0.75$, *F*(1, 30) = 91.38).
